# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 73 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 48 | Coptic

---

## Saying 73

Jesus said: "There is a vast harvest but not enough workers. Ask the Lord to send workers out into the harvest."

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "Vast harvest" — more vivid than "great" or "plentiful"
- "Not enough workers" — the scarcity framed in practical terms
- "Ask the Lord" — "ask" is more conversational than "beseech"
